evidence.what: overturned dark vehicle in contact with red semi cab blocking lanes
debris field and detached tire scattered across lanes and median
persons standing on roadway near wreckage
through traffic passing on outer lane around blockage

verdict.summary: Multi-vehicle crash with overturned truck blocks lanes; debris ahead, expect delays.
verdict.details: Aerial view of divided highway shows red tractor-trailer collided with overturned dark vehicle blocking middle lanes, blue flatbed stopped alongside. Debris and a detached tire litter roadway. Through traffic squeezes past on outer lane/shoulder. Several persons stand on roadway near wreckage. No police, fire, ambulance or tow visible.
